step1_analysis.description: A discrete-time analog ramp generator that uses a switched current source and a cascode current mirror to charge a capacitor in small steps. It is designed for ADC self-test and histogram-based testing.

paper_reference.title: On-Chip Ramp Generators for Mixed-Signal BIST and ADC Self-Test

ramp_slope.description: Average rate of change of the output voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VCTRL=0.5V, Id ~ 8.6uA. Duty cycle = 10% (0.1us/1us). Average current = 0.86uA. Slope = I/C = 0.86uA / 10pF = 86,000 V/s (or 86 V/ms).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the applied VCTRL bias and clock duty cycle.

sky130_expected.calculation: Step size = Slope * Period = 86,000 V/s * 1us = 86 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the ramp slope and clock period.

linearity_error.description: Difference in slope between different segments of the ramp (slope error).

sky130_expected.calculation: Cascode current mirror provides high output impedance, keeping current constant as VOUT rises. Error should be < 1%.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Channel length modulation is heavily suppressed by the cascode structure.

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption during ramp generation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Average current from VDD is roughly the mirror current (0.86uA) plus the diode side current (0.86uA) = 1.72uA. Power = 1.72uA * 1.8V = 3.1 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the pulsed bias current and duty cycle.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure ramp slope, step size, linearity, and power consumption of the staircase ramp generator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Staircase Ramp Generator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 N3 N3 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM7 VOUT RESET VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM6 N2 STEP VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM2 N5 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM5 N3 N2 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM4 VOUT N3 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VVSS_GND GND 0 0

* Bias and Control
VVCTRL VCTRL 0 0.5
R1 VCTRL N2 10k

* Load Capacitor
C1 VOUT VSS 10pF

* Stimulus
* RESET: High initially to discharge C1, then low to allow charging
VRESET RESET 0 PULSE(1.8 0 1u 1n 1n 100u 200u)
* STEP: Clock signal to pulse the current (1us period, 0.1us active low)
VSTEP STEP 0 PULSE(1.8 0 1.1u 1n 1n 0.1u 1u)

.control
tran 10n 20u

* Measure ramp slope between 5us and 15us
meas tran v_5u find v(VOUT) at=5u
meas tran v_10u find v(VOUT) at=10u
meas tran v_15u find v(VOUT) at=15u

let slope_overall = (v_15u - v_5u) / 10e-6
print slope_overall

* Calculate linearity error (difference in slope between two halves)
let slope1 = (v_10u - v_5u) / 5e-6
let slope2 = (v_15u - v_10u) / 5e-6
let slope_diff = slope1 - slope2
let linearity_error_pct = 100 * (slope_diff / slope_overall)
print linearity_error_pct

* Measure step size (one cycle from 5.05u to 6.05u)
meas tran v_step_start find v(VOUT) at=5.05u
meas tran v_step_end find v(VOUT) at=6.05u
let step_size = v_step_end - v_step_start
print step_size

* Measure power
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=2u to=18u
let power = -avg_current * 1.8
print power

quit
.endc
